name: Oregon and A to Z Auto Wrecking
old_description: Serving Portland, Oregon since 1937, Oregon Auto Wrecking is a one-stop shop for all your recycled automotive needs. We sell rebuilt transmissions, transfer cases, and more, plus new and aftermarket parts. Recycled auto parts are the smart and green option, as they are all quality-tested before sale, reduce waste, and are a fraction of the cost of parts from other automotive parts retailers! Plus they're backed by our guarantee including 30-day, 60-day, 90-day, and extended warranties.
about:
Oregon & A to Z Auto Wrecking has served the Portland, Oregon area since its founding in 1937. The business began as a local auto wrecking operation and has grown into a full-service automotive recycling and repair facility.

Today the company offers auto recycling, auto repair, and a comprehensive inventory of recycled and aftermarket parts. Core offerings include rebuilt transmissions, transfer cases, differential assemblies, and a wide range of electrical and mechanical components such as wiring harnesses, axle assemblies, and 4x4 parts. The facility operates a nationwide parts location service and ships via FedEx, UPS, USPS, and regional freight carriers, while providing free delivery to local repair shops and salvage yards. In-house repair capabilities cover gear ratio changes and steering column work.

The customer base spans independent automotive repair shops, salvage yards, and individual buyers across the Northwest and nationally. The company identifies itself as a leading supplier of 4x4 parts in the region and serves the automotive repair and recycling sectors.

Oregon & A to Z Auto Wrecking promotes recycled parts as a cost-effective and environmentally responsible alternative, noting that all components are quality-tested before sale and backed by warranties of 30, 60, or 90 days with extended options available. A sales staff with more than 15 years of experience in the auto recycling industry assists customers in locating specific parts.
